goal: Build the full 3-stage verification system with concrete test coverage
summary:
Phase 3 complete — all 3 stages of the verification engine are fully implemented and tested:
- Stage 1 (validateStage1): checks for null/empty/error responses
- Stage 2 (validateStage2): checks output matches task (export/function/class keywords, file extensions)
- Stage 3 (runVerifyCommand): runs shell commands, blocks on non-zero exit or timeout
- All 3 stages tested in verify.test.ts (13 tests) and agent.test.ts (15 tests)
- typecheck passes (tsc --noEmit), all tests pass
- Root package.json typecheck fixed to use tsc --build as first command
stepSummaries:

  2. Stage 2 — Output Double-Check: parse agent output and verify it matches the task requirements/plan [verified]
  3. Stage 3 — Test-Based Verification: run user-specified or auto-detected test commands and block on failure [verified]
